describe.description: The creature is a single quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile that combines the body of a brown bear with the exoskeleton and horn of a rhinoceros beetle. Its entire body except the back is covered in dense, long, shaggy brown fur that is lighter tan on the muzzle and lower sides, with a bear-like head, four thick sturdy limbs ending in clawed paws, and no visible wings or tail. A large, highly glossy, dark reddish-brown beetle carapace sits flush on its dorsal side from the back of the neck to the rump, and a single large glossy dark curved horn projects upward and backward from the center of its forehead.

describe.description: A large four-legged furry mammal standing in side profile facing right. The body, head, ears, legs and paws are those of a brown bear covered in dense shaggy brown fur with a lighter tan muzzle. Growing from the center of its forehead is a single long glossy dark curved horn with notches. Covering its back from behind the head to the rump is a glossy dark reddish-brown domed carapace like that of a beetle, with a front shield over the shoulders and a longer ridged section over the back.
